claims: The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II is a 5th-generation, single-seat, all-weather stealth multirole fighter.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II is designed for air superiority and strike missions.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II features advanced sensor integration.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II has a top speed of Mach 1.6.
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II has three main variants: A, B, C.
The F-35A is the Conventional Takeoff and Landing (CTOL) variant for the U.S. Air Force and allies.
The F-35B is the Short Takeoff/Vertical Landing (STOVL) variant capable of operating from smaller ships and austere bases.
The F-35C is the Carrier Variant (CV) with larger wing surfaces for aircraft carrier operations.
The F-35 is operated by the U.S. Air Force.
The F-35 is operated by the U.S. Navy.
The F-35 is operated by the U.S. Marine Corps.
The F-35 is operated by several international partners including the UK.
Germany is increasing its order of the F-35.
The F-35 has a radar-evading design that allows it to operate in contested airspace.
The F-35 sensor fusion combines data from multiple sensors to provide pilots with high situational awareness.
The F-35 is powered by a single Pratt & Whitney F135 engine.
The Pratt & Whitney F135 engine produces 43,000 lbs of thrust.
The F-35 has a top speed of approximately 1,200 mph.
The F-35 has a range over 1,350 miles with internal fuel.
The F-35 has an internal weapons bay for stealth with options for external mounts.
F-35 training is centered at Eglin Air Force Base.
